```{r}
##Summary of GoM trials
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
gom.trials <- fread("./clean_data/gom_trials_compiled.csv")
# Step 1: Create the main summary table
gom.trials.summary <- gom.trials %>%
  group_by(species, year_established) %>%
  tally(name = "n") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year_established,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Reorder year columns numerically
year_cols <- sort(setdiff(names(gom.trials.summary), "species"))

gom.trials.summary <- gom.trials.summary %>%
  select(species, all_of(year_cols)) %>%
  mutate(Total_Trials = rowSums(across(all_of(year_cols)))) %>%
  relocate(Total_Trials, .after = last_col()) %>%
  arrange(species)

# Step 3: Create a summary row for column totals
column_totals <- gom.trials.summary %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(year_cols), sum)) %>%
  mutate(
    species = "Total",
    Total_Trials = sum(across(all_of(year_cols)))
  ) %>%
  select(names(gom.trials.summary))  # ensure column order matches

# Step 4: Bind the summary row to the bottom
gom.trials.summary <- bind_rows(gom.trials.summary, column_totals)

# Step 5: Render with gt
gt::gt(gom.trials.summary) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "GoM Trial Summary by Species and Year Established",
    subtitle = "Number of Trials per Species per Year"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(decimals = 0) %>%
  cols_label(
    species = "Species",
    Total_Trials = "Total Trials"
  ) %>%
  opt_align_table_header("left") %>% gtsave(filename = "./graphics/GoM_trial_summary_by_species_year2.png")

fwrite(gom.trials.summary, "./clean_data/GoM_trial_summary_by_species_year.csv")
```

Assessed trial performance by year
```{r}
assessed <- fread( "./clean_data/GoM_assessed_trials_2023_24.csv")
# Prepare data with counts and percentages
performance_summary <- assessed %>% filter(species %in% c("Cw", "Fd", "Lw", "Pw", "Py")) %>% drop_na %>% 
  count(species, performance, Planted_year) %>%
  group_by(species, Planted_year) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(performance = factor(performance,
                              levels = c("Excellent", "Good", "Fair", "Poor", "Fail"),
                              ordered = TRUE))

# Stacked bar plot with counts and percentage labels
ggplot(performance_summary, aes(x = species, y = n, fill = performance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percent), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Performance Distribution by Species in GoM Assessed Trials planted 2023-24",
       x = "Species",
       y = "Count of Trials",
       fill = "Performance") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Excellent" = "darkgreen",
                               "Good" = "lightgreen",
                               "Fair" = "yellow",
                               "Poor" = "orange",
                               "Fail" = "red")) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")+
  facet_wrap(~Planted_year)

ggsave("./graphics/GoM_assessed_trials_performance_2024_25.png", width = 10, height = 6)
```

Density graphic of species across climate space
```{r}
# Load and filter data
tree.climate2 <- fread("./clean_data/Tree_Plot_Climate.csv") %>%
  filter(CoastInterior == "Interior", species %in% c("Fd", "Lw", "Py", "Pw", "Cw")) %>%
  distinct()#, "Bg""At", "Hw", 

gom.climate <- fread("./clean_data/GoM_trial_climate.csv") %>%
  filter(species %in% c("Fd", "Lw", "Py", "Pw", "Cw"))#,  "Bg""At", "Hw",

WNA.climate <- fread("D:/OneDrive - Government of BC/CommonTables/BGC_climate/WNA_BGCv13_10km.csv") %>%
  filter(!is.na(MAT), !is.na(MAP), !is.na(MSP), !is.na(MWMT), !is.na(CMD_an), !is.na(DD5_an))

gom.assessed <- fread("./clean_data/GoM_assessed_climate.csv") %>%
  filter(species %in% c("Fd", "Lw", "Py", "Pw", "Cw")) %>% #, "Bg""At", "Hw", 
  mutate(performance = factor(performance, levels = c("Fail", "Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent")))

# Define performance levels and colors
performance_levels <- c("Fail", "Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent")
performance_colors <- c(
  "Fail" = "red",
  "Poor" = "orange",
  "Fair" = "yellow",
  "Good" = "green",
  "Excellent" = "purple")

ggplot(tree.climate2, aes(x = MSP, y = MCMT)) +
  # Background climate points (grey, no legend)
  geom_point(data = gom.climate, aes(x = MSP, y = MCMT), color = "grey20", alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +

  # Assessed trials with performance-based coloring
  geom_point(
    data = gom.assessed,
    aes(x = MSP, y = MCMT, color = performance),
    size = 1.5, shape = 17, alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  # Density shading
  geom_hdr(data = tree.climate2, aes(x = MSP, y = MCMT)) +
  geom_hdr_rug(data = tree.climate2, aes(x = MSP, y = MCMT), sides = "tr", outside = TRUE) +

  # Manual color scale for performance
  scale_color_manual(
    values = performance_colors,
    drop = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17, size = 3))
  ) +

  # Optional: grayscale fill for density contours
  #scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "grey10") +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  facet_wrap(~ species, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Species-Specific Density Across Climate Space",
    subtitle = "Western North America",
    x = "MSP", y = "MCMT"
  )

ggsave("./graphics/Species_Climate_Density_w_GoM.png", width = 8, height = 10)

```


```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)

tree.climate2 <- fread("./clean_data/Tree_Plot_Climate.csv")
tree.sf <- st_as_sf(tree.climate2, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  left_join(tree.codes, by = c("Species" = "Code"))

gom.sf <- st_as_sf(gom.climate, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  filter(species %in% c("Cw", "Fd", "Lw", "Pw", "Py"))

provmap <- st_read("D:/OneDrive - Government of BC/CommonTables/BC_AB_US_Shp/BC_Province_Outline_Dissolved.gpkg")

gom.assessed <- fread("./clean_data/GoM_assessed_trials_2023_24.csv")
gom.assessed.sf <- st_as_sf(gom.assessed, coords = c("Block_long", "Block_lat"), crs = 4326)

# Define performance levels and colors
performance_levels <- c("Fail", "Poor", "Fair", "Good", "Excellent")
performance_colors <- c(
  "Fail" = "red",
  "Poor" = "orange",
  "Fair" = "yellow",
  "Good" = "green",
  "Excellent" = "purple"
)
 sp = "Cw"
for (sp in unique(gom.sf$species)) {
  gom_data <- gom.sf %>% filter(species == sp)
  tree_data <- tree.sf %>% filter(species == sp)
  assessed_data <- gom.assessed.sf %>%
    filter(species == sp) %>%
    mutate(performance = factor(performance, levels = performance_levels))

  # Apply jitter to assessed_data coordinates
  jittered_coords <- st_coordinates(assessed_data) +
    matrix(runif(nrow(assessed_data) * 2, -0.03, 0.03), ncol = 2)
  assessed_data_jittered <- st_as_sf(
    cbind(assessed_data, jittered_coords),
    coords = c("X", "Y"),
    crs = 4326
  )

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = provmap, fill = "grey90", color = "black") +
    geom_sf(data = tree_data, color = "grey50", size = 1, alpha = 0.8, shape = 1) +
    geom_sf(data = gom_data, color = "grey20", size = 1, alpha = 0.8, shape = 15) +
    geom_sf(data = assessed_data_jittered, aes(color = performance), size = 3, shape = 17, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = performance_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    coord_sf(xlim = st_bbox(provmap)[c("xmin", "xmax")],
             ylim = st_bbox(provmap)[c("ymin", "ymax")],
             expand = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal()+
    labs(
      title = paste("Tree Plot Locations for", sp),
      subtitle = "Species Distribution with Climate Data and Assessed Performance",
      color = "Performance"
    )

  ggsave(filename = paste0("./graphics/map_", sp, ".png"), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Create a data frame of shape codes
shape_df <- data.frame(
  shape = 0:25,
  x = rep(1:6, length.out = 26),
  y = rep(5:1, each = 6, length.out = 26)
)

# Plot the shape codes
ggplot(shape_df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = factor(shape)), size = 5, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = shape), vjust = -1.5, size = 4) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_df$shape) +
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle("ggplot2 Shape Codes (0–25)")
```
